mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate over the prior month compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in prior month but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two months but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and decline in FEDFUNDS indicates accommodative policy amid inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as markets price soft landing.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of instances over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1650 thousand units signal residential sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1650 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of 60-day periods following such events.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that weakens economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 100 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of 20-day periods following such events.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS rises in prior month but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm employment below 145,000 thousand persons signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS falls below 145000 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of 20-day periods following such events.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of 60-day periods following such releases.
